thread:
acme_ops: Hey team — our EU prod subaccount (acme-prod-eu) dropped to 0 credits this morning and got rate limited for ~3h. The org promo of 1000 credits should have been used after subaccount credits, but dashboard shows org credits untouched and subacct zero. Can someone look? (org: org_987)

maria_support: sorry about that — can you paste the request IDs or a couple timestamps where you saw 429s? we'll escalate to billing.

acme_ops: sure — first 429 at 2026-03-09T07:21:15Z, req: abcd1234, then 07:27:02Z req: abcd1299. attaching tiny log excerpt:
```
REQ=abcd1234 org_id=org_987 sub=acme-prod-eu path=/v1/complete status=429 token_cost=21 balance_sub=0 balance_org=850 event=charge ts=2026-03-09T07:21:15Z
REQ=abcd1299 org_id=org_987 sub=acme-prod-eu path=/v1/complete status=200 token_cost=12 balance_sub=0 balance_org=838 event=charge ts=2026-03-09T07:27:02Z
```

kevin_billing: thanks — :eyes: I see an allocator job ran around 07:20 that rebalanced credits across subaccounts. billing-bot shows "credit-allocator v3 started" at 2026-03-09T07:20:58Z. possible race where realtime charge happened just after subaccount balance read but before org-level fallback applied.

billing-bot: credit-allocator v3 triggered by schedule (workers=4) at 2026-03-09T07:20:58Z; adjusted allocations for org_987 -> distributed 1000 promo across subaccounts: acme-staging: +600, acme-prod-eu: +0, acme-prod-us: +400.

ernie_engineer: looking into allocation code — currently we do two steps w/o a per-subaccount lock: read sub balance, compute delta, write org and sub writes. If a realtime charge comes in between read and write, it can consume the delta unexpectedly and then allocator overwrites counts. likely write-order race.

maria_support: can we confirm whether the promo credits were originally tagged to org or subaccount? customer says promo applied at org level.

kevin_billing: promo is org-level. allocator's job is intended to distribute only unclaimed pool to subaccounts, but we didn't account for near-simultaneous charges. fix candidate: take a FOR UPDATE lock on subaccount row during allocation OR use conditional update with returned rows affected check.

acme_ops: so timeline is: alloc ran, real-time charges happened, tokens consumed, then alloc wrote zero to subacct? customer seeing zero while org shows full 850. feels like credits got taken from subacct first instead of fallback to org.

lisa_backfill: we'll need to backfill the 3 hours of missed credits for affected subaccounts. I'll draft a backfill plan:
1) Identify affected req IDs (time window 07:20:00-10:20:00 UTC for org_987)
2) Recompute per-request applied_credit by replaying charge events against correct allocation order
3) Issue cleanup credit adjustments (internal ledger entries) to restore subaccount balances and deduct from org promo pool
4) Notify customer and mark incident

ernie_engineer: immediate hotfix — hold allocator schedule, add per-subaccount advisory lock, and change update to "WHERE balance = <previous_read>" to avoid blind overwrites. will push hotfix in ~25m, rollout can be immediate (single region job).

kevin_billing: I'll pause allocator for org_987 and run a scan to flag other orgs where allocator ran concurrently with heavy realtime traffic.

acme_ops: appreciate it. timeline for credit restore?

lisa_backfill: estimate 6h to compute and apply backfill safely (needs approval from finance). I'll start the shaded run and post progress in this thread.

maria_support: pinging customer with temporary workaround: we've temporarily paused allocation for your org and are preparing credit adjustments. Sorry for the disruption; we'll restore credits and follow up with exact amounts. :pray:

kevin_billing: follow-up: allocator paused at 2026-03-09T08:05:10Z for org_987. preliminary scan flagged 7 subaccounts altered; starting detailed audit.

billing-bot: backfill job created ticket BF-2026-1123 assigned to lisa_backfill.

lisa_backfill: audit done — confirmed acme-prod-eu missing 1193 token-equivalent credits that were overwritten; plan to apply +1193 to subaccount and -1193 to org promo ledger (net zero impact to customer). scheduling apply at 2026-03-09T13:00:00Z UTC after finance sign-off.

acme_ops: thanks — will verify once applied. do you need anything else from our side?

maria_support: not for now, we'll reach if we need request traces. we'll update here with post-mortem and remedial steps.

ernie_engineer: hotfix deployed at 2026-03-09T08:31:42Z to staging allocator; will roll to prod after smoke tests in 10m. change includes per-subaccount advisory lock + conditional updates.

kevin_billing: prod rollout 2026-03-09T08:45:00Z — allocator resumed with safeguards.

lisa_backfill: backfill executed 2026-03-09T13:05:00Z; applied adjustments: +1193 to acme-prod-eu, -1193 to org promo pool. verified subaccount services no longer 429 for sample reqs.

acme_ops: confirmed — our errors cleared and dashboard shows corrected balances. thank you all.

maria_support: closing loop — postmortem will be written and linked here. action items: (1) add unit test for concurrent allocation/charge, (2) add monitoring for allocator vs real-time charge overlap, (3) run one-off audit for orgs with high allocator concurrency.

acme_ops: appreciated. we'll review PM and reopen if anything else.

maria_support: incident closed 2026-03-09T16:12:00Z. :white_check_mark:
